name: web-floating-panel-with-drag-handle-and-minimize-maximize-close-controls
title: White floating panel with a drag handle, title and three window buttons, over an instructional paragraph on a white page
whatItIs: A white page with a small bordered rounded panel with a soft shadow: a header with a six-dot drag handle, the title 'Floating Panel' and minimise, maximise and close icons, and a body with a two-part paragraph explaining dragging, resizing and state buttons, with a cursor above.
whatItMeans: Tool-like and light; a compact window pattern for secondary content.
techniques: Add a drag handle to the header.
Use a soft shadow for lift.

vocabulary.definition: A dotted grip showing an element can be moved.
A movable panel above the page.
The border used to resize a panel.
